manual_notes: Tier classification, view model, compact/fullscreen surfaces and bounded diff previews have substantial implementation. Strict risk-indicator scope is unresolved: the scenario requires dangerous plus Activity=execute to yield critical/Executes arbitrary code, but ComputeRisk accepts only safetyLevel and category and produces that label only for category=automation. A dangerous execute request in another category yields a different risk. This is a narrow acceptance mismatch, not abandonment.
